service_roles.label: USDA Food Safety Inspectors
service_roles.description: Inspect meat, poultry and egg products to prevent foodborne illness.

service_roles.label: Consumer Safety Officers
service_roles.description: Check the safety of medicines, medical devices and consumer products.

service_roles.label: Public Health Scientists
service_roles.description: Track disease, study health risks and help prevent outbreaks.

service_roles.label: Workplace Safety Specialists
service_roles.description: Help prevent workplace injuries and enforce safety standards.

service_roles.label: Social Security Claims Specialists
service_roles.description: Help retirees, disabled people and surviving families claim benefits.

service_roles.label: Taxpayer Phone Representatives
service_roles.description: Answer questions about tax returns, payments and refunds.

service_roles.label: Revenue Agents
service_roles.description: Audit complex tax returns and enforce tax law.

service_roles.label: Emergency Management Specialists
service_roles.description: Plan for disasters, coordinate response and help communities recover.

service_roles.label: Meteorologists
service_roles.description: Forecast weather and warn of hurricanes, tornadoes and floods.

service_roles.label: Park Rangers
service_roles.description: Protect parks, guide visitors and help with search and rescue.

service_roles.label: USGS Hydrologic Technicians
service_roles.description: Monitor rivers and groundwater to support flood warnings and water supplies.

service_roles.label: Interior Biologists & Natural-Resource Specialists
service_roles.description: Protect wildlife, habitats and public lands.

service_roles.label: EPA Environmental Protection Specialists
service_roles.description: Protect air and water through environmental programs.

outlays.basis: Actual cash paid out: SF 133 net outlays (line 4190), FY2024 vs FY2026, non-financing accounts. Outlays settle commitments from this and prior years, a different measure from new budget authority or obligations.

funding.basis: Sum of FY2024->FY2026 decreases in reported net budget authority (line 4180) across non-financing accounts, using the same values and continuity merges as the funding view. Defense cuts are included in the account total but reporting there is incomplete; the civilian-service topics below are the robust story.
